basics.name: Ally Madrone
basics.label: VP of Product at Deep Media
basics.summary: Ally Madrone is VP of Product at Deep Media, a content security infrastructure company trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and major technology platforms. He builds AI systems that detect synthetic media and disrupt fraud networks, and he speaks widely on AI-enabled financial crime.

work.name: Deep Media
work.summary: Content security infrastructure company. Owns product strategy and roadmap across the platform: Shield (detection and API layer built around the Content Genome engine), Skills (composable capability layer), and Guardian (autonomous AI agents that proactively investigate fraud, disinformation, and other digital harms across the surface, deep, and dark web). Deep Media's work is trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and major technology platforms.

work.name: Trust Stamp
work.summary: Biometric authentication and synthetic identity detection for financial services. First North American go-to-market hire: built a $10MM+ pipeline from a flat territory and hired and managed seven U.S. sales reps. Owned the deepfake detection API end to end, from authoring the PRD to packaging detection for financial crimes, KYC, and identity fraud use cases. Authored 50-page technical responses to federal RFIs.

work.name: Veriff
work.summary: Global identity verification platform. Worked a $4MM+ enterprise pipeline and beat quota by 25% or more for five consecutive quarters. Ran six-month enterprise procurement cycles with General Counsels, CISOs, and Heads of Fraud at financial institutions.

work.name: Veriff
work.summary: Veriff's first U.S. hire. Opened the U.S. market with no playbook, wrote the sales development strategy, and scaled the team from one to twelve in under a year. The team generated $50MM+ in new pipeline in its first twelve months.

work.name: Root Connection
work.summary: Founded a research and design firm and grew it from zero to $1MM in annual revenue in two years, then ran it profitably for six. Sold 50+ contracts worth $100K or more each, built the marketing engine, ran operations and accounting, managed crews and 15+ vendors, and advised regulated agriculture clients on licensing and compliance.

work.name: One Green World
work.summary: Managed a $500K+ wholesale book of business and drove B2B retail expansion for a specialty nursery. Concurrent with Root Connection.

work.name: Oregon Health & Science University
work.summary: Coordinated Phase 3 clinical trials: protocol adherence, human-subject scheduling and consent, procurement, and cross-department coordination in a regulated research environment.
